steps.en: OIC rejects and the email asking for more information is sent
steps.id: OIC menolak dan email permintaan informasi tambahan dikirim
steps.why_en: Reject works, but the email is sent at once and not scheduled.
steps.why_id: Reject berjalan, tetapi email dikirim langsung dan tidak dijadwalkan.

steps.en: OCMS automatically suspends the notice under a specific code at reject
steps.id: OCMS otomatis men-suspend notice dengan kode tertentu saat reject
steps.why_en: Rejecting does not suspend the notice; suspension only happens when a submission arrives.
steps.why_id: Penolakan tidak men-suspend notice; suspend hanya terjadi saat submission masuk.

steps.en: The suspension lasts a configurable X days while waiting for the owner
steps.id: Suspend berlaku X hari yang dapat diatur selama menunggu owner
steps.why_en: No waiting period is set at reject; the existing 21 days is fixed and starts at submission.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada masa tunggu saat reject; 21 hari yang ada tetap dan dimulai saat submission.

steps.en: The notice does not advance while the owner has not furnished again
steps.id: Notice tidak naik stage selama owner belum furnish ulang
steps.why_en: After a rejection the system stops protecting the notice, so it can advance.
steps.why_id: Setelah ditolak sistem berhenti melindungi notice, sehingga notice bisa naik stage.
